title: approval.decided v1
description: An approval request was decided by a person: approved or rejected (ADR-179). Published by alebrije-svc-notifications-ex (AlebrijeNotifications.Approvals.Publisher) on the events:approvals stream, relayed from notifications.approval_outbox, which is written in the SAME transaction as the transition (ADR-179 D7). The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data`; the envelope event_id is the outbox row id, so a consumer dedupes by event_id (a crash between the XADD and the stamp can publish a row twice). The owning module (subject_module) applies the effect in its own database; this capability never writes another module's tables. Amounts are decimal strings, never floats.

approval_id.description: The notifications.approval_requests row; the same id the internal API returned when the module created it.

kind.description: Namespaced kind chosen by the owning module (field_ops.sale_discount). Opaque to the platform: no giro is encoded in code (ADR-127).

subject_module.description: Module that owns the subject and must apply the outcome (field_ops).

subject_type.description: What the subject is inside its module (sale, settlement, credit_line).

subject_id.description: The subject's id in its own module.

context_id.description: Branch (context) of the request, when it has one.

level.description: The level the request was at when this happened.

amount.description: The amount the request was about, when it has one.

decided_by_user_id.description: The employee who decided: asked at this level or an earlier one, holding the request's required_permission, never the requester (four eyes) and never an impersonation (ADR-179 D3).

policy_version.description: Version of the tenant policy frozen into the request at creation; 0 is the platform default in code.

idempotency_key.description: The key the owning module created the request with (sale:<id>:discount), so it can find its subject without a lookup.
